extraction_notes: Only experimental CO2-hydrogenation-to-methanol performance entries in the SI were extracted. Methanol-conversion experiments, pure CO-hydrogenation experiments, DRIFTS/TPD/chemisorption characterization, diffusion-limit criteria, activation energies/reaction orders without direct plant-performance values, and literature-reference data were excluded. Several multi-series SI plots (e.g., SI Figures S3, S5-S8, S39-S41) contain many small plotted points without numerical labels; values that could not be read with confidence from the supplied SI page images were not extracted. Figure-derived numerical values reported here are approximate and marked with qualifier '~' unless printed as labels or stated in text.
